description: Financial assistance program that may help eligible members with Kaiser medical or pharmacy costs.
eligibility_description: Application required; income OR high-medical-expense criteria; regional rules apply. Do not promise approval or ask for sensitive income details unnecessarily.

description: Payment-plan information for members with outstanding Kaiser medical bills who want to pay over time.
eligibility_description: Payment plans are not financial-assistance grants. Verify bill eligibility and plan terms; if hardship is expressed prioritize FIN-01.

description: Phone-based wellness coaching to support members with health goals and healthy-habit changes.
eligibility_description: NCAL page describes no additional cost and no referral; check regional availability. Offer only after current call issue is addressed.

description: Wellness coaching resource for members who want support quitting tobacco or vaping.
eligibility_description: This is lifestyle coaching, not a guarantee of cessation medication coverage; a historical tobacco-use entry alone is not a trigger.

resource_name: Total Health Assessment and online lifestyle programs
description: Online health assessment and lifestyle programs to help members explore health goals and build a wellness plan.
eligibility_description: Only Kaiser members age 18+; may require kp.org sign-in. Do not imply the AI can see an assessment result without permission.

description: Orientation resource for members interested in Kaiser’s medical weight management program.
eligibility_description: Orientation is free; main 82-week program has charges and is not covered as a health plan benefit. Avoid body-size-based unsolicited suggestions.

resource_name: Weight Loss Options and Medications class
description: Educational class covering weight-loss options and medications.
eligibility_description: NCAL course requires clinician referral; class does not prescribe medication. Do not infer medication eligibility or offer based only on body metrics.

description: Online educational class about type 2 diabetes and day-to-day diabetes management.
eligibility_description: NCAL class says no fee and no referral; do not offer as a substitute for urgent clinical advice or individualized medication changes.

description: Peer support group for people seeking connection and support while living with diabetes.
eligibility_description: Fees may apply and local registration is required; not the same as individual diabetes treatment.

description: Educational class offering tools and techniques for emotional wellness and stress management.
eligibility_description: NCAL listing specifies adults and no fee. Do not substitute a class for requested mental health treatment or urgent assessment.

description: Information about Calm app access through Kaiser, including guided meditation and sleep-related tools.
eligibility_description: Check current age and membership eligibility; partner app access is not an insured benefit. Stress alone does not prove a Calm match.

description: Information about Headspace self-guided mindfulness, focus, sleep, and stress-support resources.
eligibility_description: Check plan and app eligibility. Distinguish self-guided tools from clinical mental health services.

description: Information about Headspace text-based emotional-support coaching.
eligibility_description: Eligible members: 90 days of coaching per year per current Kaiser page; NOT psychotherapy, urgent care, or guaranteed unlimited access.

resource_name: One Pass Select Affinity gym membership
description: Information about the optional paid One Pass Select Affinity gym membership and fitness access.
eligibility_description: Voluntary paid program, NOT a free insured gym benefit; NCAL page excludes Medi-Cal/Medicaid. Check plan and area.

description: Information about discounts for participating massage, acupuncture, and chiropractic providers.
eligibility_description: Discount on participating providers is outside insured health plan; exclusions apply. A coverage question requires a benefits check instead.

description: Information about the One Pass fitness option available with certain Medicare plan configurations.
eligibility_description: Only certain Medicare plan configurations qualify; verify Evidence of Coverage. Do not confuse with paid One Pass Select Affinity.

description: Information about Hawaii Fit Rewards, a voluntary fitness rewards program.
eligibility_description: Hawaii only; program has fees and visit requirements. Do not generalize rewards to other regions or imply a free gym membership upfront.

description: Kaiser maternity resources and support for members seeking information during pregnancy.
eligibility_description: Offer information or classes to the correct person. Do not assume a caller is pregnant based on mention of a family member.

description: Online childbirth preparation class covering topics related to labor and delivery.
eligibility_description: NCAL page lists no referral and no fee, intended for last 3 months of pregnancy; booking depends on local offering.

description: Online educational class about breastfeeding, pumping, and preparing for infant feeding.
eligibility_description: Education, not treatment for an active infant feeding issue. NCAL page says no referral and no fee; local schedule may vary.

description: Information about lactation consultation support for breastfeeding and milk-supply concerns.
eligibility_description: Clinical support may require scheduling and coverage checks. Current infant/maternal problems must be routed to care team, not only classes.

description: Educational class covering newborn care topics such as bathing, diapering, and infant sleep safety.
eligibility_description: NCAL listings say no fee and no referral; class generally aimed at final 3 months of pregnancy. Not for urgent newborn symptoms.

resource_name: Baby and Me parent support group
description: Parent support group for new parents and families with infants.
eligibility_description: Listed Berkeley location; fees may apply and session schedule may change. Parent and baby support, not an emergency care channel.

description: Group prenatal care option listed for the Oakland area.
eligibility_description: Only certain facilities, including Oakland; requires team enrollment and local scheduling. This is a model of prenatal care, not a generic class.

resource_name: Community Support Hub: food assistance connections
description: Community Support Hub pathway for finding food assistance and local food resources.
eligibility_description: Kaiser directory connects to external organizations; free food or enrollment is not guaranteed. Avoid substituting recipe resources.

resource_name: Community Support Hub: housing assistance connections
description: Community Support Hub pathway for finding housing assistance and local housing resources.
eligibility_description: External referrals have their own criteria and availability. Screen urgency and use appropriate human assistance for immediate shelter needs.

resource_name: Community Support Hub: utility-bill assistance connections
description: Community Support Hub pathway for finding assistance with utility bills and essential services.
eligibility_description: External community providers determine assistance availability. If loss of power creates a medical equipment safety risk, escalate.

description: Community Support Hub pathway for finding childcare resources in a member’s local area.
eligibility_description: Search external services by local area; no promise of free childcare, available placements, or plan coverage.

resource_name: Community Support Hub: resource specialist help
description: Community Support Hub pathway for help navigating and finding relevant community resources.
eligibility_description: Route to verified regional resource specialists; distinguish Kaiser navigation from external services and guaranteed assistance.

description: Kaiser caregiver education and support resources for people caring for family members.
eligibility_description: Confirm who is receiving care and permissions before discussing their records. General resources do not require proxy access.

resource_name: Life Care Planning and directive resources
description: Information and resources for advance care planning and documenting future healthcare wishes.
eligibility_description: This is legal/health-planning education; do not claim a chat creates a legally effective directive. Use region-specific forms.

description: Educational workshop about life care planning, advance directives, and future healthcare decisions.
eligibility_description: NCAL listing states no fee and no referral. Registration and location details may change.

description: Information about having eligible Kaiser prescriptions delivered to a member’s home.
eligibility_description: Most (not all) prescriptions qualify; confirm medication, shipping and timing. If member may run out, prioritize urgent pharmacy/clinical handling.

description: Information about automatic refills for eligible prescriptions, with member opt-in.
eligibility_description: Eligible prescriptions only; opt-in and member authorization required; never enroll automatically.

description: Information about Kaiser’s Advanced Care at Home option, a specialized care pathway directed by a clinician.
eligibility_description: ONLY attending clinician may determine suitability; verify region and coverage. Do not equate with home nursing, housekeeping, or caregiver services.
